### Model Health
- Result tables for all generic checks, with row actions and per-check headlines
- Skipped results are persisted and excluded from health counts; the skipped list refreshes correctly after undo and redo
- Configurable sheet conventions with grouped validation
- Compatible view templates are suggested without being assigned automatically
- Approved codes and field-based family naming, with explicit fixes
- Summary settings and an explicit persistence policy
- Duplicate-element safety checks and result table updates

### Filter By Parameter
- Naming rules, saved preferences and a new settings dialog

### Align Tags/Texts
- New tool for aligning tags and text notes

### Breakline
- New tool with settings dialog and summary

### Free Dims
- New mode window

### Other tools
- Level Extents updated
- Tool catalog, preferences and ribbon registration updated
